title: Conference Schedule
description: Schema for a conference schedule data file.

$schema.description: URI reference to the JSON Schema that validates this file.

events.description: All scheduled events across both conference days, ordered by day and start time.

Stage.description: The stage or venue area where the event takes place. Omitted for non-stage items such as registration or breaks.

meta:enumDescriptions.talk: Regular session talk on a stage.
meta:enumDescriptions.break: Coffee break, lunch break, or similar pause.
meta:enumDescriptions.other: Any event that does not fit the above categories.

Event.description: A single scheduled event (session, break, or activity).

day.description: ISO 8601 date of the conference day the event belongs to.

title.description: Title or name of the event.

url.description: URL to the session detail page. Omitted for events without a dedicated page (breaks, logistics, etc.).

speakers.description: Names of the speaker(s). Empty array for events with no speaker (breaks, logistics, etc.).
